Definition: Timna, the name of two Edomites
BiblicalUsage: Two Edomites carry this name, and the record keeps them distinct. Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son, and the mother of Amalek; another Timna is listed among the sons of Eliphaz himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the doubled name calls for care: the same name in the same family can belong to two different people, and the text does not confuse them even when we might.
